entry: limit 1/4 sigma of the horizon better than the close, alive the first quarter of the horizon (1 day min); exit at market at the end; vs the average market; 0.1% costs

stage.d: Weinstein stage: long stage 2 (rising 150-day average, price above), short stage 4 (falling, price below)

rs-peer.d: Relative strength vs its industry: long the leaders of their peer group, short the laggards (30 days)

laggard.d: Catch-up: long laggards of a rising industry, short leaders of a falling one (peers pull it back in line)

group-mom.d: Sector rotation: long the strongest industries, short the weakest (30-day median move vs all industries)

new-listing.d: Young listings: short markets listed on Hyperliquid in the last 90 days (supply unlocks, hype fading)

ath.d: Life cycle: long near all-time highs (within 10%: nothing overhead), short broken charts (over 80% below the high, still in stage 4)

pump-fade.d: Fade the extreme: after a 14-day move over ±50%, bet on part of it coming back

beta-tide.d: Tide: when its market (Bitcoin or the S&P 500) is above its 50-day average, long the high-beta names; below, short them

vol-squeeze.d: Coiled spring: volatility at under 60% of its own normal; bet in the direction of the last 7 days

young-small.d: Life stage of the company or coin: young (listed 2021 or later) and small or mid size = long; old giants = short (risk appetite factor)
